newsitem.title: USA: Lilly, Taisho in collaborative agreement.
newsitem.headline: Lilly, Taisho in collaborative agreement.

text.p: Eli Lilly and Co and Japan's Taisho Pharmaceutical Co Ltd have entered into a technology transfer collaboration in the field of combinatorial chemistry, the companies said.
Combinatorial chemistry increases the rate at which new chemical compounds can be created.

Under the agreement, Lilly will share with Taisho proprietary combinatorial chemistry technology. Taisho will be able to build a large, diverse library of molecules to screen against its drug targets.
The terms include upfront fees and milestones paid to Lilly for the technology transfer in unspecified amounts.
Taisho makes over-the-counter drugs. Lilly is one of the world's largest pharmaceutical companies.
